{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Soups|Soups]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*[[Cookbook:Carrot|Carrots]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*[[Cookbook:Potato|Potatoes]], diced
*[[Cookbook:Zucchini|Zucchinis]] (courgettes), diced
*[[Cookbook:Oil and Fat|Oil]] for frying
*200 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] chopped [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]]
*[[Cookbook:Chickpea|Chickpeas]], soaked '''or''' canned and drained
*Water

==Procedure==
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onions]], [[Cookbook:Carrot|carrots]], [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], and [[Cookbook:Zucchini|zucchinis]] in a spoonful of oil.
#Add [[Cookbook:Pumpkin|pumpkin]] and [[Cookbook:Chickpea|chickpeas]].
#Cover with hot water and [[Cookbook:Simmering|simmer]]. The soup is ready when the carrots are soft.
